tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Identify the signed-in Portravo account after OAuth account linking.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Find construction projects in the connected Portravo account, including draft, review, priced and final estimates. Returns 50 projects per page. Use nextOffset to continue.

tools.name: get_takeoff
tools.description: Read an owned construction project's plan files and extracted takeoff quantities, trades, confidence and human review status. Use this to summarize quantities or identify pending review. Quantities require estimator review before pricing or bidding.

tools.name: list_pricing_markets
tools.description: List the regional construction pricing markets supported by Portravo before choosing a metro_code for a new estimate.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new construction estimate project in the connected Portravo account. Supply the project name and optional address or supported metro_code. Reuse the same idempotency_key on retry to create exactly one project. Does not run extraction or consume estimate credits.

tools.name: attach_plan_pdf
tools.description: Attach a PDF selected in this conversation as the first plan for a new Portravo project. Only PDF attachments up to 25 MiB are supported.
